items.title: Trump's refugee policy: Only white South Africans welcome?
items.description: Trump is spending more money on refugees, but it's mostly white South Africans who benefit. People from crisis-stricken countries are being denied entry. Experts say the credibility of US refugee aid has been damaged.

items.title: On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk
items.description: Ukrainian drone-interceptor crews are working around the clock to stop Russian reconnaissance and attack drones approaching the frontline city of Kramatorsk. RFE/RL spent a night with one team defending the skies as aerial attacks intensify.

items.title: Surrounded by warring factions, Sudan’s el-Obeid must rely on local relief
items.description: Several hundred thousand civilians in the Sudanese city of el-Obeid are caught in the middle of fighting between rival military forces, relying in part on humanitarian aid from local activists.
